DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談はお二人で受けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will both of you attend the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいについては一緒に聞きたいです。ただ、私の収入の話は一人で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同席相談と個別収入相談を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: We would like to hear about housing together. However, I would like to discuss my income alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to separate the joint consultation from the private discussion of your income. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中で同席の方に席を外していただく希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You would like the other person to leave partway through, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自分から言い出しにくいので、話題が変わる時に声をかけてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退席を促す声かけを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It is difficult for me to bring it up, so could you prompt them when the topic changes?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to prompt the other person to leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者へその希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass that request on to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。同居人には、個人の情報は別に聞くと先に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同居人への事前説明を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will explain to my housemate beforehand that personal information will be discussed separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to explain this to your housemate in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料も分けて扱う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do your documents also need to be handled separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の給与明細は別の封筒にあります。共有する資料と混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与資料の共有を避けるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My payslips are in a separate envelope. Please do not mix them with the documents we are sharing.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to avoid sharing your salary documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約の連絡先はどちらにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Which contact should we use for the appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の携帯でお願いします。同居人の番号ではなく、用紙のこの欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の予約連絡先を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: My mobile, please. It is this field on the form, not my housemate's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify your own contact details for the appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同席の範囲と連絡先を担当へ引き継ぎます。個人資料は封筒のままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on the limits of the joint discussion and your contact details. Please keep your personal documents in their envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記念切手をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for commemorative stamps?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人へ贈る分と、自分の手紙に使う分が欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈答と実使用の記念切手を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like some as a gift for a friend and some to use on my own letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about commemorative stamps for gifts and for actual use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: シートのまま残すご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like to keep them as a sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 贈る分は絵を一枚で見たいので、切り離したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: シート絵を切らず贈る希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: For the gift, I want the picture to remain whole, so I do not want to separate the stamps.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to give the sheet without cutting up its picture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う分は別に選ぶこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can choose separate stamps for your own use.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、このシートを贈り、自分の分は必要な額面を別に買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自用の額面を別購入する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will give this sheet and buy the denominations I need for myself separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy the denominations for your own use separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送る手紙の料金は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you checked the postage for the letter you are sending?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。好きな絵だけで、貼る金額まで決めない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 絵の選択と郵便料金を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I should not decide how much postage to attach just by choosing a picture I like, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish choosing the picture from determining the postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完成した郵便物の重さなどから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check it from the completed mail item's weight and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。今日は贈るシートだけ買い、手紙の分は完成後に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 贈答分のみ購入し自用分を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I will buy only the gift sheet and check the stamps for my letter once it is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy only the gift stamps and postpone those for your own use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: シートを折らずにお渡しします。ご自分の郵便用は、手紙の準備ができてからご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give you the sheet without folding it. Please ask about your own postage once your letter is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having difficulty filling in your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。普段は短い署名ですが、本人確認書類には長い名前が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 略した署名と正式氏名の違いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I normally use a short signature, but my identification document shows my full, longer name.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between your abbreviated signature and your official name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前の欄と署名の欄を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the name field and the signature field?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。氏名欄には書類どおりに書きましたが、署名欄はまだ空白です。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名記入済みと署名未記入を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I wrote my name exactly as it appears on the document, but the signature field is still blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that your name is filled in and your signature is not. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 署名方法は担当が申込みの内容と合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check how you should sign along with the details of your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、今ここで略して書かずに、担当へ聞いてから記入したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 署名前の担当者確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like to ask the staff before filling it in, rather than abbreviating it here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check with the staff before signing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認書類は原本をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the original identification document?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。これです。名前の順番も書類のとおりでよいか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認原本と名前順の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, here it is. Please also check whether the order of my names should match the document.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your original ID and ask them to check the order of your names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that point on too.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。氏名欄を勝手に書き直さず、この用紙を持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認欄を保留して待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will wait with this form instead of rewriting the name field myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the unconfirmed field blank and wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 署名と名前の順番の確認ですね。原本と用紙を担当者にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We are checking the signature and the order of your names. Please show the staff the original document and the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集合写真の場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a place for a group photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一人は写真に入らず荷物を持ちます。皆と離れずに立てる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影しない同行者も近くで待てる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. One person will hold our bags and stay out of the photo. Is there somewhere they can stand without being separated from everyone?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the companion who is not being photographed can wait nearby. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通り道を避けて、こちらの広い所を使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this wide area, away from the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 撮る人の横に立てば、見学する人の邪魔になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影者横の待機位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: If they stand beside the photographer, will they be out of the visitors' way?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the waiting position beside the photographer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 壁際に寄り、入口の前を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please stay by the wall and keep the area in front of the entrance clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。荷物は地面に置かず、友人に持ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を地面に置かない方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. We will not put our bags on the ground; I will have my friend hold them.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not put the bags on the ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影中も通行する方への配慮をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please remain considerate of people passing through during the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人が来たら一度やめます。撮る人もこの広い所から出ないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行時の撮影中断を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will pause if anyone comes. The photographer will also stay within this wide area.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Promise to pause the photo when people pass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 皆さんへ伝わっていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。場所を説明してから並びます。長く場所を占めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員への説明と短時間利用を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We will explain the location before lining up. We will avoid occupying the space for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain it to everyone and use the space briefly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでお願いします。入口を空けたまま、短時間で撮影してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Keep the entrance clear and take the photo quickly.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品について何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the artwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この線はひびでしょうか。見る位置を変えると消えるので、よくわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 消える線がひびかどうか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this line a crack? It disappears when I change my viewing position, so I am not sure.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the line that disappears is a crack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 触れずに、展示線の外から角度を変えて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Without touching it, look from different angles outside the display boundary.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 横からなら表面の線ではなく、奥の影にも見えます。作品解説に説明がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 角度による見え方と解説の有無を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: From the side it looks like a shadow farther back rather than a line on the surface. Does the artwork's description explain it?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe how the appearance changes with the angle and ask whether the description explains it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 短い解説はありますが、その線については書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a short description, but it does not mention that line.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、ひびだと決めつけず、見え方が変わるという感想にしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 損傷断定を避け感想を言い換える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not conclude that it is a crack. I will just describe my impression that its appearance changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid concluding that it is damage and rephrase your impression. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点を案内担当に聞くこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also ask the information staff about it.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞いてみたいです。作品名と、どこから見た時の線かを伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当へ伝える情報を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to. Should I tell them the artwork's name and where I was standing when I saw the line?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check what information to give the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。位置を指で示す際も、作品に近づき過ぎないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Even when pointing out the location, please do not get too close to the artwork.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。ここから見える中央の線について尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鑑賞位置と線の場所を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will ask about the central line visible from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify your viewing position and the line's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へご案内します。作品に触れず、ご覧になった位置から説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the staff. Please explain from where you viewed it without touching the artwork.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この魚をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at this fish?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。重さで値段が決まるなら、頭を取る前と後のどちらで量るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 料金計算の基準重量を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If the price is based on weight, is it weighed before or after the head is removed?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which weight is used to calculate the price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この売場では、処理前の重さで値段をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this counter we quote the price using its weight before preparation.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、頭を取っても表示額は同じですね。処理を頼む前に総額を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 処理前後の価格と総額を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then the displayed price stays the same even after removing the head, right? I would like to know the total before asking for preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the price before and after preparation and the total cost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 下処理の料金も合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the preparation charge as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。頭は持ち帰らず、身だけ受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 頭を受け取らない下処理を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I would like only the flesh, without taking the head home.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for preparation that leaves out the head when you collect the fish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切り身にしますか、そのままにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like it cut into portions or left as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人で焼くので、二つに分けてください。骨が残るかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人分の分割と残骨を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will grill it for two people, so please divide it in two. Please also tell me whether any bones will remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for two portions and whether bones remain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 骨が残る場合があります。食べる時にご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Some bones may remain. Please be careful when eating it.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。総額を聞いてから、この魚にするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 価格確認後に購入判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will decide whether to buy this fish after hearing the total.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide whether to buy it after checking the price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まず総額をお伝えします。ご了承いただくまで、魚の処理は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell you the total first. We will not start preparing the fish until you agree.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: What can I help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先日、拾った財布を交番へ届けました。その後の問い合わせ先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得物届けの後の照会先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: The other day I handed a wallet I found in to a police box. I would like to know where to make a follow-up inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to inquire after reporting found property. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届けた交番の名前はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the name of the police box?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。控えに書いてあります。今日はその交番へ行けず、こちらに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交番控えと別窓口へ来た事情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is on the receipt. I cannot go there today, so I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the police box receipt and explain why you came to another counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えの番号を担当部署に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the receipt number with the department in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。持ち主の個人情報ではなく、私が追加で何かする必要があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 拾得者側の追加対応だけを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not want the owner's personal information; I only want to know whether I need to do anything else.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask only about any further steps required from you as the finder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お届け後に連絡先は変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have your contact details changed since you handed it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話番号が変わりました。控えの番号と一緒に新しい番号を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先変更を控え番号と共に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: My phone number has changed. I would like to give the new number together with the receipt number.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report your changed contact details together with the receipt number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が本人確認も含めてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain the procedure, including identity verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。控えを見せて、更新が必要か相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当へ控えを示して更新相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will show the receipt and ask whether an update is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the staff your receipt and ask about an update. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 遺失物担当へおつなぎします。控えをお持ちのまま、連絡先の変更をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with lost property staff. Keep your receipt with you and tell them about your changed contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which product are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に目薬を頼まれました。この写真と似た箱が二つあって迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た目薬の写真による特定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family asked me to buy eye drops. There are two boxes similar to this photo, and I am unsure which to choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help identifying eye drops from a photo of similar products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真では商品名の一部が読めませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Part of the product name is unreadable in the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。色だけで選びたくありません。家族へ確認するなら何を聞けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱色を避けて確認項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not want to choose by color alone. What should I ask my family to confirm?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid choosing by box color and ask what details to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正式な商品名と、箱に書かれた種類を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the full product name and the type written on the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族は今すぐ返事できません。薬を買わず、候補の名前だけメモしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返答まで購入保留し候補を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family cannot reply immediately. May I note the candidate names without buying the medicine?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Postpone buying until you receive a reply and record the candidates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。お使いの方については薬剤師にもご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please also consult the pharmacist about the person who will use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。私の症状に合うかではなく、家族が使っている品を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用者が家族であると明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I want to confirm the product my family member uses, rather than whether it suits my own symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that the user is your family member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 薬剤師にそのようにお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the pharmacist that.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認できるまでは、どちらも購入しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特定前は購入しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not buy either one until I can confirm it.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not buy before identifying the product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 薬剤師へご案内します。写真と候補のメモを見せて、ご本人の情報が未確認とお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the pharmacist. Show the photo and your candidate notes, and say that the user's information is not yet confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの鞄をお試しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try this bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冬の上着の上から肩に掛けられるか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冬上着越しの鞄試着を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to see whether I can carry it on my shoulder over a winter coat.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to try the bag over a winter coat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今お召しの上着で試されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you try it with the coat you are wearing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 薄いので、持ってきた厚い上着に替えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 厚い持参上着への着替えを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one is thin, so may I change into the thick coat I brought?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to change into the thick coat you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。肩ひもの長さはここで調整できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. You can adjust the shoulder strap here.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。最大まで伸ばす前に、肩に掛けた位置を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調整前に肩掛け位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Before extending it fully, I will check where it sits on my shoulder.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the shoulder position before adjusting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中に入れる物は重いですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事の書類です。空の鞄では軽すぎるので、試す方法がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類重量を想定した試用を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Work documents. The empty bag is too light, so is there a way to test it?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to test it with the weight of documents in mind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本の重りを入れて確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check it with sample weights inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。上着の上でも長さと重さが合えば、この鞄にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 長さと負荷を踏まえ購入判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do that. If the length and weight work over my coat too, I would like this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to buy after considering the strap length and load. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見本の重りをご用意します。持ちやすさを確かめてからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will prepare the sample weights. Please choose after checking how comfortable it is to carry.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受け取りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。予約はローマ字ですが、荷物はカタカナの名前で届いていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約と荷物の名前表記の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My reservation uses Roman letters, but I think the parcel has arrived under my name in katakana.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference in how your name is written on the reservation and parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名と配送番号はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the addressee name and tracking number?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この発送メールにあります。部屋番号は発送時にまだ決まっていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配送番号と未確定だった部屋番号を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are in this shipping email. My room number had not yet been decided when it was sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the tracking number and explain that the room number was not yet decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約情報と照合して、保管場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will match it against your reservation and check where it is stored.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。同じ苗字の別のお客様の物と間違えないよう、番号も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同姓客との混同を避け番号照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Please check the number too so it is not confused with another guest's parcel under the same surname.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the number to avoid confusion with a guest of the same surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取はご本人でよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。本人確認書類を持っています。荷物は一箱です。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人受取と箱数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I have identification. It is one box.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are collecting it yourself and state the number of boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できるまで、少しお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Could you wait a little until we can confirm it?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ロビーで待ちます。確認後にこちらへ呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ロビーでの待機と呼出しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will wait in the lobby. Please call me there once it is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to wait in the lobby and be called there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛名と配送番号で確認します。確認が済みましたら、ロビーでお声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the addressee and tracking number. Once confirmed, we will call you in the lobby.
